units.source_text: 确实，眼下正是需要沉着冷静的时候……

en.t: Indeed, now was precisely the time to stay calm and collected...

units.source_text: 自己还没摸清对方的意图，与其横冲直撞，

en.t: Since he still had not grasped the other side's intentions, rather than charging ahead blindly,

units.source_text: 眼下不如面对现实，盘算切实的逃跑计划……

en.t: for now it would be better to face reality and work out a practical escape plan...

units.source_text: 追究不法行为当在其后……

en.t: Pursuing the matter of their illegal acts could come afterward...

units.source_text: 但空着肚子会丧失意志的。

en.t: But on an empty stomach, one's will would give out.
Nor could he concentrate his mind.

units.source_text: 话虽这么说，可要是真打算拒绝现状的话，

en.t: That said, if he truly meant to reject the present situation,

units.source_text: 当然也应该包括吃饭，彻底地拒绝一切。

en.t: then naturally that should include eating, and he ought to reject everything completely.

units.source_text: 一边生她的气，一边吃她做的饭，实在滑稽得很。

en.t: It was truly absurd to be angry at her while eating the food she had made.

units.source_text: 就是一条狗，给它吃东西的时候，也会垂下尾巴的。

en.t: Even a dog, when it is given something to eat, will lower its tail.
